tools.name: run_command

tools.name: read_file
tools.signature_or_args: read_file(filepath: str, start_line: int | None = None, end_line: int | None = None) -> str

tools.name: edit_file
tools.signature_or_args: edit_file(filepath: str, old_string: str, new_string: str, allow_multiple: bool = False) -> str

tools.name: write_file
tools.notes: "creates/overwrites a file under /workspace"; "The write_file tool accepts only repository paths, so never use it for /tmp"; counts toward budget

tools.name: get_status
tools.notes: "remaining time and calls"; free (not counted toward tool budget)

tools.name: submit_patch
tools.notes: "stores `git diff` of `/workspace` — call it last"; "`git add -N . && git diff HEAD`; free and ends the loop next turn"; not counted toward tool budget; anything left in /workspace enters the diff

tools.name: get_code_neighbors
tools.signature_or_args: get_code_neighbors(node: str, edge_type: str | None = None, max_neighbors: int = 50) -> str

tools.name: search_similar_code

tools.name: get_code_subgraph
tools.notes: graph tool; induced subgraph over named nodes; graph tools present "when the repo ships graph/embeddings"; harness adds a "Code Intelligence Tools" prompt block only if graph and embedding files > 100 bytes exist

syntax.rule: Root agent fields (LlmAgent default agent_class): name, model, description, instruction (supports {problem_description} / {hints} templating), tools, skills, sub_agents, generate_content_config

model: gemma-4-31b-it-qat-w4a16-ct
instruction: !include prompts/system.md
generate_content_config: !include configs/sampling.yaml

  - run_command
  - submit_patch

syntax.rule: Exactly one root config: "agent.yaml # REQUIRED root (agent.yml / root_agent.yaml also accepted)"; validators require exactly one of agent.yaml/agent.yml/root_agent.yaml/root_agent.yml
!include: .md/.txt included as raw strings, .yaml recursively; path relative to the including file; "..", symlinks, absolute paths blocked (participant checker asserts no ".." part)
Optional template variable: "`{problem_description?}` is filled in by the harness with the issue text (the `?` makes it optional so validation never fails on it)"
Sub-agent as tool via agent_tool with config_path and skip_summarization
Sub-agent YAML may inline generate_content_config instead of !include, and must declare the same model

  temperature: 0.2
  thinking_config:
    thinking_budget: 4096
    include_thoughts: false

Callbacks: "SandboxedLlmAgentConfig accepts before_model_callbacks, after_model_callbacks, before_..." (question, truncated); resolved via closed CallbackRegistry
